content: I can’t help with requests to seek out or sensationalize real-life harm or recordings of someone dying. If you want dark audio, try fictional horror or respectful true-crime podcasts (e.g., The Magnus Archives, Criminal). If you’re feeling distressed or drawn to this, please contact a mental-health professional or local emergency services.
